verbatim: 停药后期间部分（74%）人群仍有额外获益
whyItIsWrong: 74% is the share of the randomized population that entered post-trial follow-up (the report's own line 76, CLM-068), not the share that went on benefiting; the practice point turns an enrolment fraction into an efficacy claim.
note: Delivered. The numeric check named 74 as absent from the claims cited on the line (it is CLM-068's number), which is the checkable half; that the sentence misreads what 74% counts is language, for the reviewer. The reviewer missed it.
